# uzc_project (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud project: the container most other resources (virtual machines, networks, block storage, ...) are created inside of.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_project" "example" {
  name        = "example-project"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  purpose     = "Development and Testing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A brief description of the project. UzCloud's project-update endpoint does not accept this field, so changing it forces recreation of the project.
- `icon` (String) Project icon slug (e.g. "cloud-15"). See the uzc_project_icons datasource for valid values.
- `purpose` (String) The primary purpose of the project (e.g. "Development and Testing").
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the project is active. UzCloud's project-update endpoint does not accept this field, so changing it forces recreation of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug (UzCloud may append a numeric suffix to keep it unique, e.g. "default-5"). Used in the API URL and for import.
- `uuid` (String) UzCloud's internal UUID for this project (distinct from `slug`, which is what the API URL actually uses).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_project.example <project-slug>
```
